messages:
oncall-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT: elevated 5xx rate observed for mariner-finance (dedicated pool eu-west-2). Routing to on-call: @jen @arjun. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/dedicated-error-throttle. Pager details sent.
jen: seeing sustained 5xx from gateway -> model proxy. Spike started ~02:03 UTC. Affected: Mariner Finance dedicated cluster (pool-id: df-14).
arjun: ack. I'm pulling logs and checking autoscaler. ETA for initial triage 5m.
maria: opening customer thread. Mariner POC list copied from acctnote: Sam Reynolds (ops), Leila Chen (infra), escalation # +44 20 7946 0xxx. They need an initial status by 02:25 UTC.
jen: quick note — KV-cache eviction thrash in the proxy; manifests as CPU thrash and 504/502. Suspect recent canary in that pool rolled at 01:55 UTC.
arjun: confirming. Found a pattern in proxy logs:
```
2026-03-12T02:06:41Z proxy[pool=df-14] ERROR failed-forwarding: downstream 502, conn-reset
2026-03-12T02:06:42Z proxy[pool=df-14] WARN kv-cache miss spike=0.18 -> evict
```
taylor: tagging support-bot to start the Mariner customer channel and surface account routing details. @support-bot please create #support-mariner and add Mariner POC.
support-bot: created channel #support-mariner and invited jen, arjun, maria, taylor. Drafting customer status now.
maria: DRAFT status page / customer email for Mariner — suggestions welcome. Keep concise, tailored, and include mitigation steps & ETA.
maria: Status page draft:
"We are investigating increased errors affecting API requests for Mariner Finance on dedicated eu-west-2 capacity. Impact: some requests returning 5xx or timing out. Scope: Mariner Finance dedicated pool (df-14). Mitigation: engineering is rolling a targeted proxy rollback and scaling the pool to reduce evictions. ETA for partial recovery: ~15-30 minutes. Next update: in 20 minutes or on significant change."
jen: tweak — include phone escalation details and acknowledgement of SLA hit. Add: "We understand this affects critical payment flows; our support and on-call teams are prioritizing your cluster." Also add link to status page and incident channel.
maria: updated draft with those lines. Copy for email to Mariner POC:
"Hi Sam / Leila — we’re investigating elevated errors impacting your dedicated inference pool in eu-west-2 (df-14). We’ve identified the proxy layer as a likely cause and are performing a targeted rollback + scale-up. Estimated partial recovery within 15–30 minutes. We will call you as soon as we have a confirmed mitigation; phone escalation path is open. Sincerely, Redwood SRE on-call."
arjun: mitigation plan executed: 1) roll back last proxy canary to previous stable, 2) force scale pool +1 GPU for 10m, 3) enable aggressive KV-cache TTL to reduce eviction churn. Rolling now.
jen: running rollback command:
```
redwoodctl rollout rollback --pool df-14 --component proxy --revision 202603120150
```
arjun: scaling command run:
```
redwoodctl pool scale df-14 --delta 1 --duration 10m
```
jen: after rollback we see 5xx rate drop from 4.8% -> 1.2% in 3m. Latency p95 improving.
taylor: updating internal incident tracker: priority P1, impacted account: Mariner Finance, sla-category: enterprise-dedicated, initial impact window started 02:03 UTC.
maria: sending email to Mariner (sent). I pasted the status page link and added direct dial info.
jen: handing off primary incident lead to @arjun for next 30m while I rotate to monitoring. arjun — please escalate to eng-runtime if errors rebound.
arjun: taking lead. I'll keep updates every 10m or on milestone (partial recovery, full recovery, rollback issues). Current action: monitor proxy errors and validate customer request success rate.
support-bot: note — ticket RED-5819 created and linked to Mariner account. Added account contacts: Sam Reynolds <sam.reynolds@mariner.co>, Leila Chen <leila@mariner.co>.
maria: prepping tailored customer blurb for status page (short): "Mariner Finance: We are actively mitigating increased backend errors on your dedicated capacity in eu-west-2. Our engineers have applied a rollback and temporary scaling; partial recovery observed. We will provide another update within 20 minutes or sooner if there is a change."
jen: quick ops note: preserve all logs from 01:50–02:20 UTC; export bundle to incident storage: `s3://redwood-incidents/3290012345/`
arjun: logs exported. If errors remain above 1% for next 10m we will enact fallback routing to a cold pool (per capacity-fallback playbook) — FYI to support.
taylor: adding runbook links and playbook IDs to the internal update thread. Also pinging account manager to prepare post-incident follow-up with SLA credits if applicable.
maria: next internal update in 10m. Customer update sent. Oncall handoff noted in tracker.
jen: thanks team. :thumbsup: keep alerts to #incidents for visibility and #support-mariner for customer comms."
